answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities with work-bonded copper stakes: every new identity must lock a refundable copper deposit and build a kernel of signed, verified task receipts before earning full trust. A comet burst of fresh sybil accounts cannot fake that history — each fake needs its own deposit plus real completed work, so the attacker's cost grows linearly per identity while honest agents reuse one established reputation. Slashing the deposit on proven fraud makes mass fakery unprofitable.
